import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 12;

    static class FlowEdge {
        int to, rev;
        long flow, cap, cost;

        FlowEdge(int to, int rev, long flow, long cap, long cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static FlowEdge[][] edges = new FlowEdge[5000][5000];
    static int[] edgeCount = new int[5000];
    static long totalMinCost;

    static void initFlow(int n) {
        totalMinCost = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            edgeCount[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < 5000; ++j) {
                edges[i][j] = null;
            }
        }
    }

    static void addFlowEdge(int u, int v, long cap, long cost) {
        totalMinCost = Math.max(totalMinCost, cap);
        edges[u][edgeCount[u]] = new FlowEdge(v, edgeCount[v], 0, cap, cost);
        edgeCount[u]++;
        edges[v][edgeCount[v]] = new FlowEdge(u, edgeCount[u] - 1, 0, 0, -cost);
        edgeCount[v]++;
    }

    static boolean[] visited = new boolean[5000];
    static int[] prevEdge = new int[5000];
    static long[] potential = new long[5000];
    static long[] dist = new long[5000];

    static void setupPotential(int n) {
        Arrays.fill(potential, 0);
        for (int iter = 1; iter < n; ++iter) {
            for (int node = 0; node < n; ++node) {
                for (int idx = 0; idx < edgeCount[node]; ++idx) {
                    FlowEdge e = edges[node][idx];
                    if (e != null && e.cap > 0) {
                        if (potential[e.to] > potential[node] + e.cost) {
                            potential[e.to] = potential[node] + e.cost;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long findAugmentingPath(int src, int dst, long[] totalCost, int nodeCount, boolean useBFS) {
        Arrays.fill(visited, 0, nodeCount, false);
        Arrays.fill(dist, 0, nodeCount, INF);
        dist[src] = 0;

        if (useBFS) {
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(src);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (visited[u]) continue;
                visited[u] = true;
                for (int idx = 0; idx < edgeCount[u]; ++idx) {
                    FlowEdge e = edges[u][idx];
                    if (e != null && e.flow < e.cap && dist[e.to] > dist[u] + potential[u] - potential[e.to] + e.cost) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[u] + potential[u] - potential[e.to] + e.cost;
                        prevEdge[e.to] = idx;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int u = src; u != -1; ) {
                visited[u] = true;
                for (int idx = 0; idx < edgeCount[u]; ++idx) {
                    FlowEdge e = edges[u][idx];
                    if (e != null && e.flow < e.cap && dist[e.to] > dist[u] + potential[u] - potential[e.to] + e.cost) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[u] + potential[u] - potential[e.to] + e.cost;
                        prevEdge[e.to] = idx;
                    }
                }
                u = -1;
                long best = INF;
                for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; ++i) {
                    if (!visited[i] && dist[i] < best) {
                        best = dist[i];
                        u = i;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (dist[dst] >= INF) return 0;

        long bottleneck = INF;
        for (int node = dst; node != src; ) {
            int idx = prevEdge[node];
            FlowEdge revEdge = edges[node][idx];
            FlowEdge forwardEdge = edges[revEdge.to][revEdge.rev];
            bottleneck = Math.min(bottleneck, forwardEdge.cap - forwardEdge.flow);
            node = revEdge.to;
        }

        for (int node = dst; node != src; ) {
            int idx = prevEdge[node];
            FlowEdge revEdge = edges[node][idx];
            FlowEdge forwardEdge = edges[revEdge.to][revEdge.rev];
            forwardEdge.flow += bottleneck;
            revEdge.flow -= bottleneck;
            totalCost[0] += bottleneck * forwardEdge.cost;
            node = revEdge.to;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; ++i) {
            potential[i] = Math.min(INF, dist[i] + potential[i]);
        }
        return bottleneck;
    }

    static long minCostMaxFlow(int src, int dst, long[] totalCost, int nodeCount, boolean useBFS) {
        setupPotential(nodeCount);
        long totalFlow = 0;
        totalCost[0] = 0;
        while (true) {
            long df = findAugmentingPath(src, dst, totalCost, nodeCount, useBFS);
            if (df == 0) break;
            totalFlow += df;
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        final int source = 0;
        final int sink = n * T + 1;

        initFlow(sink + 1);

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            addFlowEdge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            addFlowEdge(1 + t * n, sink, INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    addFlowEdge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    addFlowEdge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    addFlowEdge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] price = new long[1];
        long flow = minCostMaxFlow(source, sink, price, sink + 1, true);
        System.out.println(price[0]);
    }
}
